name: margin-companion
description: Shows Margin's notes in the editor margin only at natural pauses, and offers a quiet break when you've been stuck a while. Never pops up.

margin.pauseSeconds.description: Seconds without typing that count as a natural pause. Held notes appear at a pause.

margin.stuckMinutes.description: Minutes of little progress (long idle, or mostly deleting) before the status bar quietly offers a break.

margin.suggestBreaks.description: Quietly offer a break in the status bar when you seem to have stalled. It never pops up.
